value.rationale: The invariant density near an indifferent fixed point is a natural quantitative object in intermittent dynamics. A bounded, undetermined residual becomes an exact intercept plus a signed first vanishing correction; competition between neutral and source-injection powers occurs at the naturally selected half-parameter boundary. The neutral coefficient is provably nonzero below that boundary; derivative nonvanishing above it is not assumed. No downstream mixing or memory-loss statement is inferred.
